widgets_values:
LOSSLESS CLIP CHAINING
----------------------
Chaining through video costs a decode + re-encode at every join.
That round trip darkens the picture ~2.4% each time and compounds.
Chaining the latent skips it entirely.

RUN 1 (first clip)
  Load Latent stays BYPASSED (it is, already).
  seed_video feeds the continuity as usual.
  -> Save Latent writes output/h3_latents/clip_00001

RUN 2 ONWARD
  1. Select Load Latent, press Ctrl+B to un-bypass it.
  2. Pick the newest file in its dropdown (newest is first).
  3. Write the new prompt. Run.
  -> Save Latent writes clip_00002, and so on.

NOTES
  seed_video can stay connected: once seed_latent is wired it is
  used only to supply real audio for the continuation window.

  Resolution is locked once you start. A latent cannot be resized,
  so every clip in a chain must use the same one.

  To redo a clip, just load the previous latent again. Nothing
  earlier needs re-rendering.

NAMING
  Set filename_prefix on Save Latent per scene, e.g. sato_scene
  -> sato_scene_00001, sato_scene_00002 ...
  You can also rename files afterwards in
  ComfyUI/output/h3_latents/ - keep the .safetensors ending
  and they stay in the dropdown.

Style_definitions:
keep same style,
grounded live-action crime drama film aesthetic with crisp organic texture.
cool blue-toned institutional lighting with desaturated shadows.
Arri Alexa 35 cinema camera with 50mm prime lens, shallow depth of field.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Detective Vance in <Picture 1>. consistent this is the single person in <Picture 1>, with exactly the appearance of <Picture 1>, unchanged in every shot.

<Subject 2> is Sato in <Picture 2>. consistent he is the single person in <Picture 2>, with exactly the appearance of <Picture 2>, unchanged in every shot.

<Subject 3> is Officer Davis in <Picture 3>. consistent he is the single person in <Picture 3>, with exactly the appearance of <Picture 3>, unchanged in every shot.

<Subject 4> is the interrogation room location in <Picture 4>. Build the environment from <Picture 4>.

[Reference Continuity: <Video 1>]

[Reference Continuity: <Video 1>]

Source Reference: Use <Video 1> as the anchor for environment, and all visible assets.

Character Continuity: preserve the character's facial structure, hairstyle, body proportions, and wardrobe from <Video 1>.

Environment & Set: Retain the identical background environment, architectural layout, spatial geometry, and atmosphere established in <Video 1>.

Props & Set Dressing: Keep all props, furniture, background objects, and items present in <Video 1> fully intact and consistent without random additions or alterations.

Lighting & Tone: Match the exact ambient lighting, color palette, and visual mood seen in <Video 1>.

Identity, clothing, composition, lighting, background, and object placement remain unchanged.

Sound & Voice Continuity: Preserve the exact voice characteristics, tone, and cadence already established for every returning speaker in <Video 1>, and continue the same ambient environment sound and atmosphere.

summary:
[reference generation + video continuation] Officer Davis opens the door for Detective Vance, who enters the interrogation room; Davis exits and shuts the door, and Vance sits across from Sato to question him, with Sato replying defensively.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 4> fully preserved - the interrogation room backdrop is reproduced from this image.

detailed_description:
The environment.

Every defined subject keeps exactly the appearance of its own reference image throughout the video, unchanged and identical on both sides of every cut, without drifting, morphing, or exchanging anything with another subject, and each defined subject appears exactly once in any frame, with no duplicate, mirrored or leftover copy visible at the same time. The door and every object keep their exact shape and never merge with any body; there is only one door, it stays mounted in its frame on its hinges, and no second door, copy of it, or loose panel ever appears. Movement throughout is natural and grounded for every subject, with realistic weight transfer and follow-through, and no jittery, floating, or impossible motion.

[continuation shot]: At 00:01.500, medium-wide shot of <Subject 4> framing <Subject 2> seated at the table and the room's single door in clear view, maintaining scale continuity from the prior footage without a distant wide snap. <Subject 3> stands beside the door, reaches out, turns the handle, and smoothly opens the door halfway while stepping back to maintain open clearance from its swing. <Subject 1>, the detective, steps through the doorway into the room, clearing the doorframe with visible space between him and <Subject 3>. <Subject 2> remains seated at the table, watching. Only <Subject 1>, <Subject 2>, and <Subject 3> are visible; no other figure appears in frame. The camera holds steady with subtle tracking. By the end of the shot <Subject 1> is inside the room, <Subject 3> holds the door open, and <Subject 2> stays seated.

[continuation shot]: At 00:04.200, the medium-wide shot continues smoothly as the camera gently reframes toward the table without a cut. <Subject 3> steps forward through the doorway, turns back to grip the outside handle, and pulls the door shut until the latch engages, leaving <Subject 3> outside and unseen. Simultaneously, <Subject 1> walks at an unhurried, measured pace to the empty chair across from <Subject 2>, pulls out the chair slightly, and lowers into the seat. Only <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> are visible once the door latches. The camera eases in closer to a medium two-shot across the table. By the end of the shot <Subject 1> is seated across from <Subject 2>, and <Subject 3> remains unseen.

[continuation shot]: At 00:07.000, medium shot of <Subject 1> at the table, reached without a cut as the camera gently pushes in past <Subject 2>'s shoulder. <Subject 1> leans slightly forward, chest drawing a steady breath. <Subject 1>, in a low, firm, authoritative voice, says: [English] "Start talking, Sato. Who was you with?" His jaw moves naturally with the cadence, his gaze locked across the table. <Subject 2> keeps his mouth closed and forms no speech shapes. The camera settles as the line concludes. By the end of the shot <Subject 1> sits forward, gaze held, and <Subject 2> remains seated across from him.

[continuation shot]: At 00:08.800, hard cut to a medium close-up of <Subject 2> at the table, facing across toward <Subject 1>. <Subject 1> is out of frame. <Subject 2>'s brow furrows and his chin lifts in defensive tension. <Subject 2> says: [English] "I already told you, I didn't do anything." His jaw articulates each syllable sharply, lips pressing into a taut line upon finishing. The camera holds static. By the end of the shot <Subject 2> remains seated and silent, chest rising with held breath, while <Subject 1> remains out of frame and <Subject 3> remains unseen.

overall_soundscape:
The ambient environment sound and atmosphere established in the prior footage continue uninterrupted and at consistent volume, and Sato's voice keeps the tone and presence it already had. The door latch clicks open followed by firm footsteps entering the room. The door pulls shut with a solid latching sound, accompanied by the muffled scrape of a chair across the floor as Vance sits, leading into the distinct vocal acoustics of the interrogation dialogue.
